comment: Token deployer (PLAN.md §7e). pin_backend: 'pumpfun' uses pump.fun's unofficial metadata upload endpoint, 'pinata' pins via Pinata (needs PINATA_JWT). Costs in SOL. create_cost_sol_estimate = rent + accounts headline shown in the pre-deploy confirm. priority_fee_sol is applied silently to every deploy (no UI field — no launchpad exposes one). create_slippage_bps mirrors pump.fun's own frontend constants (SOL creates 0, token-quoted creates 1000): a create+buy is atomic on a fresh curve, so user-facing slippage is meaningless. vanity.pool_target keypairs ending in vanity.suffix are pre-ground in data/vanity/.
